name: polygon-apothem

name: polygon-diagonals

name: osculating-circle

name: tangent-graph

name: phyllotaxis-spiral

name: tractrix

draw: A kidney shaped closed curve with two cusps pointing inward from each side.

name: epicycloid
draw: A small circle rolling around the outside of a larger circle, tracing a curve with five sharp cusps.

name: conical-spiral
draw: A spiral that winds upward around an invisible cone, wide at the bottom and narrowing to a point at the top.

name: penrose-tiling

name: rhombille-tiling

name: trihexagonal-tiling
draw: A tiling of hexagons separated by small triangles, forming a star of lines pattern.

name: cairo-pentagonal-tiling

name: truchet-tiles

name: islamic-geometric-pattern

name: aperiodic-monotile

name: fish-scale-pattern

name: dragon-curve

name: cantor-set
draw: Stacked horizontal bars, each row splitting the one above into two with the middle third removed.

name: menger-sponge

name: sierpinski-carpet

draw: Three curved spiral arms radiating from a shared center, each ending in a small coil.

name: cafe-wall-illusion

name: hering-illusion
draw: Two straight parallel lines crossing a fan of radiating lines so they appear to bow outward.

name: spherical-coordinates

name: convex-hull

name: area-under-curve

name: full-angle
draw: A single ray from a center dot with a circular arrow sweeping all the way around it, marking 360 degrees.

name: euler-diagram
